additions.midnightconfig.EnableFastLeafD:

When disabled, vanilla behavior is used.

シャベルで草ブロックと草の道を切り替えられるようになります
additions.midnightconfig.EnabledTranslat: 翻訳の自動ダウンロードを有効にします
Delay (in ticks) before leaves update their distance from logs.
§aLower values§r = faster decay, but §cmay cause lag§r in large forests.
§eRecommended§r: 1–3
additions.midnightconfig.TranslationCoun: How often community translations are refreshed, counted in game starts (e.g. 3 = every 3rd launch).
additions.midnightconfig.aboutHandwerk:
Handwerk (German for "craftsmanship"). 

Vanilla-style tools that do the work for you: AoE hammer & shovel, vein miner, tree feller, harvester scythe. Plus tool upgrades, magnet enchantments & a full building palette — slabs, stairs, trapdoors, lanterns, redstone chains.
additions.midnightconfig.features: ここに記載されている設定は完全に開発されており、安全に使用できます。
